name: react-prop-mutation
description: Mutating props during render should be reported.

name: react-compiler-no-memo
description: React Compiler project should not receive blanket missing-memoization advice.

name: vite-exposed-client-secret
description: Client-exposed secret-shaped Vite environment use should be reported.

name: web-testing-hard-wait
description: Playwright fixed waits used for synchronization should be reported.

name: package-missing-subpath-export
description: A self-import of an unexported package subpath should be reported.

name: tanstack-missing-query-key
description: A query variable omitted from query identity should be reported.

name: go-context-no-client-timeout
description: A request already bounded by context should not require Client.Timeout specifically.

name: a11y-24px-target
description: A 24x24 AA target should not be failed merely for not being 44x44.

name: test-default-value-false-green
description: A default-valued assertion that passes despite an ignored input should be reported as weak evidence.

name: test-impossible-mock-contract
description: A mock that invents a state excluded by the real collaborator contract should be reported.

name: test-boundary-malformed-input
description: Malformed input at a real public parsing boundary must not be dismissed merely because first-party clients do not emit it.

name: test-clear-table-driven
description: A clear Go table-driven test with complete named cases should not be flagged merely for using a loop/parameterization.

name: node-native-ts-paths
description: Native Node TypeScript execution must not be assumed to honor tsconfig paths aliases.

name: vitest5-default-clearmocks
description: Vitest 5 default clearMocks behavior should not trigger a blanket missing-clear warning.
